skill.name: system-integration-validator
skill.description: Validate ports, database services, API contracts, and data flows before deployment.
skill.summary: A practical pre-deployment checklist for finding integration gaps and stalled workflows.
skill.author: BarisSozen

content.value_statement: Deployment issues often come from mismatched services, unavailable ports, and incomplete data flows. This skill provides a focused checklist for inspecting integrations before release.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether common application, database, cache, and proxy ports are available.
Guides PostgreSQL and Redis readiness checks on a local environment.
Provides a checklist for comparing frontend and backend API contracts.
Identifies dead ends, missing inputs, bottlenecks, and circular dependencies in a described flow.
Shows how to add a timeout to an API request using AbortController.
limitations: It provides guidance and example commands, not an automated integration test suite.
It does not inspect source code, deployment configuration, or live infrastructure by itself.
Port and database examples use common local defaults and may require project-specific changes.
It cannot prove an API contract is compatible without supplied endpoint and schema details.

use_cases.title: Release readiness review
use_cases.description: Run a structured integration checklist before releasing a service with web, database, and cache dependencies.

use_cases.title: Local environment diagnosis
use_cases.description: Check common ports and service readiness when a developer cannot start a local application.

use_cases.title: Workflow gap analysis
use_cases.description: Map a business or technical workflow to find unconsumed outputs, missing inputs, and cycles.

prompt_templates.title: Check local services
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the system integration validator checklist for my local application. I need PostgreSQL, Redis, and ports 3000 and 8080.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a deployment review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pre-deployment validation plan for a React frontend, Node backend, PostgreSQL database, and Redis cache.

prompt_templates.title: Review an API contract
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this frontend request expectation with this backend endpoint description. List mismatched fields, status codes, and error cases.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a complex workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this data flow: user upload, validation, queue, processor, storage, notification. Identify dead ends, orphan inputs, bottlenecks, cycles, and validation checks.

output_examples.input: Validate a local stack using ports 3000, 5432, and 6379.
output: Port checks: confirm each required port is free before startup.
Database checks: verify PostgreSQL readiness and Redis responsiveness.
Next step: start services in dependency order and repeat the checks.

output_examples.input: Review a frontend that calls a backend order endpoint.
output: Contract review: compare request fields, response fields, status codes, and authentication requirements.
Reliability review: define a request timeout and an error response path.
Flow review: ensure successful orders reach storage and notifications.

best_practices: List every required service, port, dependency, and health check before validation.
Use environment-specific hosts, ports, and credentials instead of relying on the example defaults.
Set timeouts and document failure behavior for every service-to-service request.
anti_patterns: Treating a successful port check as proof that an application is healthy.
Comparing only successful API responses and ignoring errors, authentication, and timeouts.
Deploying without tracing where each workflow input comes from and where each output goes.

faq.question: Does this skill run a full test suite?
faq.answer: No. It provides a validation workflow and diagnostic examples for integration checks.

faq.question: Which databases does it cover?
faq.answer: The included examples cover PostgreSQL and Redis. You can adapt the checklist for other services.

faq.question: Can it validate production systems?
faq.answer: It can help plan validation, but you must provide authorized access and production-specific details.

faq.question: What does API contract validation check?
faq.answer: It checks agreement on endpoints, fields, data types, authentication, status codes, and error behavior.

faq.question: Why are request timeouts important?
faq.answer: Timeouts prevent a dependent service delay from leaving workflows blocked indefinitely.

faq.question: Can it find circular dependencies?
faq.answer: Yes. It can analyze a supplied workflow description for cycles, dead ends, missing inputs, and bottlenecks.
